page.overview:
Who is Bertie?

Bertie was from the African nation of South Africa. She is dark skinned and has black curly hair. After experience working with wildlife she was hired by Simon Masrani to work as the head animal trainer at his park, Jurassic World. In this job she led other employees in the management and wellbeing of the dinosaurs that lived in the park. She and a team of twelve normally worked with young herbivores, helping them integrate into the habitats after they hatched. Bertie was also in charge of feeding Rexy, the resident Tyrannosaurus rex who came from Jurassic Park. These feedings happened on Thursdays while most of the carnivore caretakers were on Isla Sorna.

While Bertie was the head trainer in 2004, it is unknown if she remained in that position 11 year later by the events of the 2015 Isla Nublar Incident.
